text:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — planning a staggered cutover to the new ratecard v3 next Tue. Start with 10% of accounts as cohort A. Need ops checklist, billing reconciliation steps, and confirmation on grandfathering logic. Who's in?
Trevor Chen: cohort by monthly spend < $5k sounds reasonable. Also need invoice preview to confirm rounding/line-item behavior.
Jonah Ruiz: +1 on cohort. Exclude enterprise contracts with committed seats from cohort A. For grandfathering I'd prefer a 6mo ramp rather than immediate switch.
Tara Singh: Who will own customer comms? Legal needs to review the billing terms language before we send notices.
billing-bot: Invoice preview generated for cohort A (10%): https://redwood-internal/preview/1765432100 — CSV attached.
Maya Patel: Pushed draft price sheet and rollout config to Drive: https://drive.internal/redwood/ratecard-v3. Config snippet: ```cohort: low_spend
traffic_percent: 10
grandfather_months: 6
effective_date: 2026-04-07
exclude_tags: [enterprise_committed]```
Trevor Chen: I can run the recon job on staging: billing_recon_v2 with the preview CSV. Will check rounding issues (we saw 0.5 token rounding last quarter).
Jonah Ruiz: Note — embedding unit aggregation caused duplicate usage lines in last migration. Smoke test should assert unique invoice lines per model + window.
Tara Singh: Legal: +1 with one edit to the notice copy. Ping @Maya with updated language. Also ask Finance for approval on grandfathering terms & any promo credits.
Maya Patel: 👍 I'll update the draft and tag finance approvers. @Jonah can you add a smoke test to CI to validate invoice uniqueness?
Jonah Ruiz: Added smoke/pricing-cutover to CI. Steps: 1) enable feature flag; 2) run billing_recon_v2; 3) validate invoices against golden CSV. I'll run it tomorrow morning.
billing-bot: Deploy queued: price-rollout/2026-04-07 by @Maya Patel — scheduled window: 02:00 PT.
Trevor Chen: FYI infra requests DB migration window at 02:00 PT on cutover day; plan for 20m maintenance and rollback playbook ready.
Maya Patel: Noted. We'll reserve the window and include rollback steps in the runbook. Any objections to 6mo grandfathering? If none I'll mark as accepted.
Evan Brooks: Evan (Finance): Finance approves contingent on successful invoice preview and smoke test passing. Please share final preview export.
Priya Malhotra: Priya (Finance Ops): Approved. Request a new GL mapping for delta lines so reporting separates legacy vs new pricing.
Maya Patel: Done — created ticket FIN-1284 for GL mapping and updated the rollout ticket with the communications draft. Thanks all, I'll follow up after the smoke run tomorrow.
